name: code-quality-mentor
description: Turn PMD warnings into a personalized learning plan. Scans a Git repository with PMD, attributes each warning to its git-blame author, and synthesizes a tailored LEARNING_PLAN.md for a chosen developer with concept explanations, refactor sketches of their actual code, and verified external pointers.

plugins.name: code-quality-mentor
plugins.description: Slash command /code-quality-mentor:scan that runs PMD across a repo, attributes warnings by git blame, lets you pick one developer, and writes a focused LEARNING_PLAN.md with concept explanations, refactor sketches of the author's own flagged code, and pointers to canonical references.
